decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core offer costs little to carry as a distributed product, and its prospects are still unresolved after one year, so the option is worth keeping.

UV spot varnishing is distant from the core and somewhat riskier, but it was promoted at a German premiere event and the uncertainty has not yet resolved, so keeping the low-cost wholesale option is justified.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established portfolio and supports automated workflows, so it is cheap to keep while demand is still unclear.
The B2 multifinisher was featured as a flagship launch on the home page and fits the move toward automation, so its option value remains high.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the core booklet-making business and has low carrying cost, and no negative signals have appeared.
The folding add-on unit already shows a customer installation running in one pass, which is positive early evidence for a low-cost complement to the core line.
